# BD Solar Power (bdsolarpower.com)

> Rooftop solar installation guidance and site-specific surveys for homes and businesses across Bangladesh.

## Verified public facts

- BD Solar Power currently states a 5kW rooftop solar system starting from BDT 275,000, subject to site survey and final scope.
- A free site survey and net-metering documentation support are offered.
- The stated panel warranty is 25 years; final terms depend on the selected product documentation.
- Service is offered nationwide, subject to assessment and scheduling.
- Contact: hello@bdsolarpower.com; WhatsApp +880 1711 927755.
- Policy, incentive, generation, savings and payback information must be verified for the specific project before purchase.
